page_title: HAV 0-1 BRE | Le Havre v Brest 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+4' Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Kenny Lala (Brest) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Mathieu Gorgelin was alert and the score remains the same.
85' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
85' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The referee signals a corner kick to Brest.
84' Here's the change. Mama Balde leaves the pitch and Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
84' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Romain Faivre and he is replaced by Edimilson Fernandes (Brest).
81' Looks like Mama Balde (Brest) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
80' That's the end of the game for Arouna Sangante, who is replaced by Yoann Salmier (Le Havre).
80' The game has come to an end for Rassoul Ndiaye. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ilyes Housni (Le Havre).
78' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Mathieu Gorgelin.
73' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Soumaila Coulibaly is replaced by Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest).
67' Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the right post!
66' Substitution. Issa Soumare walks off the pitch and Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.
64' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kamory Doumbia (Brest) replacing Romain Del Castillo.
64' Substitution. Abdallah Sima makes way for Mama Balde (Brest).
61' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
58' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) gets a yellow card.
58' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
57' A cross into the box from Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is cleared.
55' Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

50' A neat pass is well received by Romain Del Castillo (Brest), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
46' The game is over for Emmanuel Sabbi. Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre) comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Didier Digard probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Oussama Targhalline. He is replaced by Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre).
46' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' A pass into the box finds Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Marco Bizot denies him.
43' The foul by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) was seen by Romain Lissorgue who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
41' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

39' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.

39' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Mathieu Gorgelin pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
34' Abdallah Sima (Brest) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
33' Romain Faivre (Brest) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Mathieu Gorgelin makes a great save.
30' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Kenny Lala (Brest).
29' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

28' Abdallah Sima (Brest) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Now Brest have a corner.

25' 0 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:1.
25' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
24' Kenny Lala (Brest) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
24' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Brest get a free kick.
22' The referee shows the yellow card to Romain Faivre (Brest).
20' An attempted cross from Kenny Lala (Brest) is cleared.
17' Brest are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
13' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
13' Kenny Lala (Brest) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play and Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Abdallah Sima (Brest) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest.
10' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
8' The ball rebounds out to Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
7' Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to Mahdi Camara (Brest) for his blatant foul.
6' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle as Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
6' Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) was too forceful with his tackle and Romain Lissorgue interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
5' Mathieu Gorgelin pulls off a great save to deny Romain Del Castillo (Brest) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
4' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is given a yellow card.
2' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) was quite harsh and Romain Lissorgue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
1' The match has just started.
Le Havre will kick-off.
Romain Lissorgue will officiate today.
